definitions: A common foot problem characterized by dry, flaky skin on the heels that has developed fissures or cracks, often causing discomfort or pain.
A condition where the skin on the back of the foot, specifically the heel, becomes dry and splits open.
examples: She applied a special cream to her cracked heels.
Cracked heels can be a sign of dehydration.
Regular moisturizing helps prevent cracked heels.
